caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting a section of interior architectural woodwork. The composition shows a wall with a large, centrally positioned arch-shaped feature, possibly a porthole, outlined by a smooth molding. On either side of this archway are two fluted pilasters with ornate Corinthian-style capitals that display classical scroll and leaf motifs. Above the pilasters runs an elaborately decorated entablature with a cornice featuring a repeating pattern of ornamental moldings. The lower part of the wall is divided by baseboards. Rectangular panels, bordered with simple linear moldings, are visible on the sections of the wall besides the central arch and on the far right of the composition. The lines are clean and precise, creating a clear depiction of the woodwork's structural elements. The drawing is set on an off-white or yellowed background consistent with aged paper. At the bottom left, the label reads "USS Hartford," and at the bottom right, it reads "Woodwork - Porthole."
title: Porthole and Woodwork Detail
